# Cancelled tasks have a separate filter bit without becoming completed tasks

The owned change adds a readonly isCancelled getter based on STATUS and keeps isCompleted separate. Cancellation uses bit 16; ALL becomes 31. The property filter checks that bit rather than requiring an exact ALL-mask match, so the open filter excludes a cancelled task while all includes it. The direct unit test checks those two cases only. This source finding does not prove every custom status combination or rendered task behavior; the primary discussion still has missing comments.

Scope: Calendar task status filtering.
